request: Build a seed planter in this empty project. A green sphere named `Seed` (radius 0.5) is the template; it waits out of sight at x = 0, y = -5, z = 0. Once every second of game time (60 fixed ticks, the first at tick 60), plant a copy of it: the n-th copy is named `Seed n` (`Seed 1`, `Seed 2`, ...) and placed at x = 2n, y = 0.5, z = 0. Stop after 5 copies. A counter named `planted` starts at 0 and counts the copies.
